     6|module
     7|
     8|public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.AbsMax
     9|public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.RemovableSingularity
    10|
    11|/-!
    12|# Schwarz lemma
    13|
    14|In this file we prove several versions of the Schwarz lemma.
    15|
    16|* `Complex.norm_deriv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball`, `Complex.abs_deriv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball`: if
    17|  `f : ℂ → E` sends an open disk with center `c` and a positive radius `R₁` to a closed ball with
    18|  center `f c` and radius `R₂`, then the norm of the derivative of `f` at `c` is at most
    19|  the ratio `R₂ / R₁`;
    20|
    21|* `Complex.dist_le_div_mul_dist_of_mapsTo_ball`: if `f : ℂ → E` sends an open disk with center `c`
    22|  and radius `R₁` to a closed disk with center `f c` and radius `R₂`, then for any `z` in the former
    23|  disk we have `dist (f z) (f c) ≤ (R₂ / R₁) * dist z c`;
    24|
    25|* `Complex.abs_deriv_le_one_of_mapsTo_ball`: if `f : ℂ → ℂ` sends a point `c` to itself
    26|  and it maps an open disk with center `c` to the closed disk with the same center and radius,
    27|  then the norm of the derivative of `f` at the center of this disk is at most `1`;
    28|
    29|* `Complex.dist_le_dist_of_mapsTo_ball_self`: if `f : ℂ → ℂ` sends a point `c` to itself
    30|  and it maps an open disk with center `c` to the closed disk with the same center and radius,
    31|  then for any point `z` of this disk we have `dist (f z) c ≤ dist z c`;
    32|
    33|* `Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball_self`: if `f : ℂ → ℂ` sends an open disk with center `0` to
    34|  itself, then for any point `z` of this disk we have `abs (f z) ≤ abs z`.
    35|
    36|## Implementation notes
    37|
    38|We prove some versions of the Schwarz lemma for a map `f : ℂ → E` taking values in any normed space
    39|over complex numbers.
    40|
    41|## TODO
    42|
    43|* Prove that any diffeomorphism of the unit disk to itself is a Möbius map.
    44|
    45|## Tags
    46|
    47|Schwarz lemma
    48|-/
    49|
    50|open Metric Set Function Filter TopologicalSpace
    51|
    52|open scoped Topology ComplexConjugate
    53|
    54|variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {R R₁ R₂ : ℝ} {f : ℂ → E}
    55|  {c z z₀ : ℂ}
    56|
    57|/-- An auxiliary lemma for `Complex.norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball`. -/
    58|private theorem Complex.schwarz_aux {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
    59|    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R₁) :
    60|    ‖dslope f c z‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
    61|  have hR₁ : 0 < R₁ := nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩
    62|  suffices ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[<] R₁, ‖dslope f c z‖ ≤ R₂ / r by
    63|    refine ge_of_tendsto ?_ this
    64|    exact (tendsto_const_nhds.div tendsto_id hR₁.ne').mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    65|  rw [mem_ball] at hz
    66|  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT hz] with r hr
    67|  have hr₀ : 0 < r := dist_nonneg.trans_lt hr.1
    68|  replace hd : DiffContOnCl ℂ (dslope f c) (ball c r) := by
    69|    refine DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl ?_
    70|    rw [closure_ball c hr₀.ne']
    71|    exact ((differentiableOn_dslope <| ball_mem_nhds _ hR₁).mpr hd).mono
    72|      (closedBall_subset_ball hr.2)
    73|  refine norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le isBounded_ball hd ?_ ?_
    74|  · rw [frontier_ball c hr₀.ne']
    75|    intro z hz
    76|    have hz' : z ≠ c := ne_of_mem_sphere hz hr₀.ne'
    77|    rw [dslope_of_ne _ hz', slope_def_module, norm_smul, norm_inv, mem_sphere_iff_norm.1 hz, ←
    78|      div_eq_inv_mul, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hr₀, ← mem_closedBall_iff_norm]
    79|    exact h_maps <| mem_ball.2 <| by rw [mem_sphere.1 hz]; exact hr.2
    80|  · rw [closure_ball c hr₀.ne', mem_closedBall]
    81|    exact hr.1.le
    82|
    83|@[expose] public section
    84|
    85|namespace Complex
    86|
    87|/-- Two cases of the **Schwarz Lemma** (derivative and distance), merged together. -/
    88|theorem norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
    89|    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R₁) :
    90|    ‖dslope f c z‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
    91|  have hR₁ : 0 < R₁ := nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩
    92|  have hR₂ : 0 ≤ R₂ := nonempty_closedBall.mp ⟨f z, h_maps hz⟩
    93|  rcases eq_or_ne (dslope f c z) 0 with hc | hc
    94|  · rw [hc, norm_zero]; exact div_nonneg hR₂ hR₁.le
    95|  rcases exists_dual_vector ℂ _ hc with ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩
    96|  have hg' : ‖g‖₊ = 1 := NNReal.eq hg
    97|  calc
    98|    ‖dslope f c z‖ = ‖dslope (g ∘ f) c z‖ := by
    99|      rw [g.dslope_comp, hgf, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]
   100|      exact fun _ => hd.differentiableAt (ball_mem_nhds _ hR₁)
   101|    _ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
   102|      refine schwarz_aux (g.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hd) (MapsTo.comp ?_ h_maps) hz
   103|      simpa only [hg', NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using g.lipschitz.mapsTo_closedBall (f c) R₂
   104|
   105|/-- Equality case in the **Schwarz Lemma**: in the setup of `norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball`, if
   106|`‖dslope f c z₀‖ = R₂ / R₁` holds at a point in the ball then the map `f` is affine. -/
   107|theorem affine_of_mapsTo_ball_of_exists_norm_dslope_eq_div [CompleteSpace E] [StrictConvexSpace ℝ E]
   108|    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
   109|    (h_maps : Set.MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂))
   110|    (h_z₀ : z₀ ∈ ball c R₁) (h_eq : ‖dslope f c z₀‖ = R₂ / R₁) :
   111|    Set.EqOn f (fun z => f c + (z - c) • dslope f c z₀) (ball c R₁) := by
   112|  set g := dslope f c
   113|  rintro z hz
   114|  have h_R₁ : 0 < R₁ := nonempty_ball.mp ⟨_, h_z₀⟩
   115|  have g_le_div : ∀ z ∈ ball c R₁, ‖g z‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := fun z hz =>
   116|    norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps hz
   117|  have g_max : IsMaxOn (norm ∘ g) (ball c R₁) z₀ :=
   118|    isMaxOn_iff.mpr fun z hz => by simpa [h_eq] using g_le_div z hz
   119|  have g_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball c R₁) :=
   120|    (differentiableOn_dslope (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball_self h_R₁))).mpr hd
   121|  have : g z = g z₀ := eqOn_of_isPreconnected_of_isMaxOn_norm (convex_ball c R₁).isPreconnected
   122|    isOpen_ball g_diff h_z₀ g_max hz
   123|  simp only [g] at this
   124|  simp [g, ← this]
   125|
   126|theorem affine_of_mapsTo_ball_of_exists_norm_dslope_eq_div' [CompleteSpace E]
   127|    [StrictConvexSpace ℝ E] (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
   128|    (h_maps : Set.MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂))
   129|    (h_z₀ : ∃ z₀ ∈ ball c R₁, ‖dslope f c z₀‖ = R₂ / R₁) :
   130|    ∃ C : E, ‖C‖ = R₂ / R₁ ∧ Set.EqOn f (fun z => f c + (z - c) • C) (ball c R₁) :=
   131|  let ⟨z₀, h_z₀, h_eq⟩ := h_z₀
   132|  ⟨dslope f c z₀, h_eq, affine_of_mapsTo_ball_of_exists_norm_dslope_eq_div hd h_maps h_z₀ h_eq⟩
   133|
   134|/-- The **Schwarz Lemma**: if `f : ℂ → E` sends an open disk with center `c` and a positive radius
   135|`R₁` to an open ball with center `f c` and radius `R₂`, then the norm of the derivative of
   136|`f` at `c` is at most the ratio `R₂ / R₁`. -/
   137|theorem norm_deriv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
   138|    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (h₀ : 0 < R₁) :
   139|    ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
   140|  simpa only [dslope_same] using norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps (mem_ball_self h₀)
   141|
   142|/-- The **Schwarz Lemma**: if `f : ℂ → E` sends an open disk with center `c` and radius `R₁` to a
   143|closed ball with center `f c` and radius `R₂`, then for any `z` in the former disk we have
   144|`dist (f z) (f c) ≤ (R₂ / R₁) * dist z c`. -/
   145|theorem dist_le_div_mul_dist_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
   146|    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R₁) :
   147|    dist (f z) (f c) ≤ R₂ / R₁ * dist z c := by
   148|  rcases eq_or_ne z c with (rfl | hne)
   149|  · simp only [dist_self, mul_zero, le_rfl]
   150|  simpa only [dslope_of_ne _ hne, slope_def_module, norm_smul, norm_inv, ← div_eq_inv_mul, ←
   151|    dist_eq_norm, div_le_iff₀ (dist_pos.2 hne)] using norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps hz
   152|
   153|/-- The **Schwarz Lemma**: if `f : ℂ → ℂ` sends an open disk of positive radius to itself and the
   154|center of this disk to itself, then the norm of the derivative of `f` at the center of
   155|this disk is at most `1`. -/
   156|theorem norm_deriv_le_one_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R))
   157|    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R) (closedBall (f c) R)) (h₀ : 0 < R) : ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ 1 :=
   158|  (norm_deriv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps h₀).trans_eq (div_self h₀.ne')
   159|
   160|/-- The **Schwarz Lemma**: if `f : ℂ → ℂ` sends an open disk to itself and the center `c` of this
   161|disk to itself, then for any point `z` of this disk we have `dist (f z) c ≤ dist z c`. -/
   162|theorem dist_le_dist_of_mapsTo_ball_self (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R))
   163|    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R) (closedBall (f c) R)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R) :
   164|    dist (f z) (f c) ≤ dist z c := by
   165|  simpa [(nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩).ne'] using dist_le_div_mul_dist_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps hz
   166|
   167|/-- The **Schwarz Lemma**: if `f : ℂ → E` sends an open disk with center `0`
   168|to the closed ball with center `0` of the same radius,
   169|then for any point `z` of this disk we have `‖f z‖ ≤ ‖z‖`. -/
   170|theorem norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball_self (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball 0 R))
   171|    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball 0 R) (closedBall 0 R)) (h₀ : f 0 = 0) (hz : ‖z‖ < R) :
   172|    ‖f z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
   173|  simpa [h₀] using dist_le_dist_of_mapsTo_ball_self hd (by rwa [h₀]) (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hz)
   174|
   175|end Complex
